page.notes: The small blue marks under the page numbers are reference underlines and are not transcribed. The right column is cut off after its fourth line on this part. Blue underlinings beside the page numbers are not printed text and are not transcribed. The page numbers themselves are transcribed as printed. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept within the index lines (e.g. "con-tinuò", "ani-mæ", "spe-ctantium", "repræ-sentant" written as printed on the line). The accent on "Plato" in the first entry is not clear and may be a mark rather than an accent. The entry "Principia rerum natura-" is the last line of the page; its continuation is the catchword.
